needs_human.note: A kept null-origin row is displayed under Related files, not Links to this file, until Y is saved (groupRelations.ts:10).; A missing Y (missing_since set) counts as a Markdown source because _markdown_source_ids applies no active filter, so its row waits as a trashed note's row does. No test pins this.; A pre-origin (Y, X) row where Markdown Y never linked X, such as one written by an addon before origins existed, now also waits for Y's save rather than going on X's save.; A pre-origin seed row from a Markdown source to a note (source, note) now survives the note's uncited save and waits for the source's save. The existing seed tests use only a video source.

A kept pre-origin row (Y, X, NULL) for a live link is listed under Related files, while docs/user-guide/tags-and-relations.md:64 describes that section as relations made some other way, such as by an addon. It moves to Links to this file only after Y's next save.; A pre-origin row from a Markdown note is now kept on X's save whatever Y's file says, because the code does not read Y's content. A row Y's file does not back stays listed on X until Y is saved.; Missing Markdown sources are kept like trashed ones, because _markdown_source_ids applies no active-file filter. Only the trashed case has a test.
